games.name: HopSketch
games.description: Draw your own weapon and armour, an AI judges how good your drawing is, then your fighter battles everyone else's creations. The worse your art, the funnier it gets.

games.name: Hop Party
games.description: A 3D party board game: roll dice, race around the board, steal goblets from your friends and fight it out in quick minigames between turns.

games.name: HopKart
games.description: Kart racing for up to 12 friends: drift, grind rails, glide off jumps and fire items at whoever is in first place.

games.name: HopGolf
games.description: Mini golf where everyone plays the same hole at once, so you can knock your friends' balls off line. 27 holes.

games.name: HopPool
games.description: 8-ball pool in a corner bar, 1v1 or 2v2, with spin and jump shots.

games.name: HopBar
games.description: A liar's bluffing card game: lay your cards face down, call out whoever you think is lying, and hope the chamber is empty when you're caught.

games.name: HopBusiness
games.description: A fast property board game: buy cities, build hotels and bankrupt your friends.

games.name: HopUp
games.description: A climbing race up a giant junk tower. Run, wall-run and bounce your way up; first to the top wins, and everyone else falls a long way.

games.name: HopParkour
games.description: Rooftop tag: sprint, wall-run, vault and slide across the city to stay away from the chasers, or hunt everyone down when you're it.

games.name: HopSmash
games.description: A platform fighter: grab weapons and knock your friends off the island.
